summary: Adds an mpmath-specific `_print_Rational` that emits `mpf(p)/mpf(q)`, correctly forcing rationals to full mpmath precision and resolving the reduced-precision nsolve issue. Approach mirrors the existing `_print_Float` mpmath override and is a minimal, correct fix.
